name: Sheikh Hasina
role: Awami League leader and prime minister during the 2024 uprising
contribution: As prime minister, she led the Awami League government during the July-August 2024 crackdown and resigned on 5 August 2024 after the student-led uprising reached a decisive national rupture.
context: Bangladesh politics from the anti-Ershad movement through the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement and post-resignation transition.
impact: Her resignation turned the protest wave into a state-transition moment and made accountability for protest repression a central public question.
seoDescription: Profile of Sheikh Hasina, tracing her role in the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement, protest crackdown, resignation, and Bangladesh transition politics.
shortAnswer: Sheikh Hasina is linked to the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement as the prime minister whose government faced the uprising and resigned on 5 August 2024.
